mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series_group e JOIN series c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.series_group_id = e.series_group_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name AND c.name = i.name )

SELECT g.name AS group_name, i.name AS name, i.description AS description, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id JOIN series_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN series c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.series_group_id = e.series_group_id AND c.name = i.name LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE_SERIES' AND t.target_id = i.template_series_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY g.template_series_group_id, i.template_series_id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(series_group_id), 0) FROM series_group WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(series_id), 0) FROM series WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO series_group (user_id, name, description) SELECT #{userId}, g.name, g.description FROM template_series_group g WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_group e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name)

INSERT INTO series (user_id, series_group_id, name, description) SELECT #{userId}, e.series_group_id, i.name, i.description FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id JOIN series_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM series c WHERE c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.series_group_id = e.series_group_id AND c.name = i.name )

INSERT INTO thumbnail_image (user_id, target_type, target_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) SELECT #{userId}, 'SERIES_GROUP', e.series_group_id, t.file_path, t.original_name, t.file_size FROM template_series_group g JOIN series_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND t.target_id = g.template_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND e.series_group_id > #{maxGroupId}

INSERT INTO thumbnail_image (user_id, target_type, target_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) SELECT #{userId}, 'SERIES', c.series_id, t.file_path, t.original_name, t.file_size FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id JOIN series_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN series c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.series_group_id = e.series_group_id AND c.name = i.name JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE_SERIES' AND t.target_id = i.template_series_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND c.series_id > #{maxItemId}
